announcements.headline: Exosens supports Germany’s Future Soldier pro...
announcements.insight: Exosense Shs supports Germany’s Future Soldier pro. This follows a recent major order for image intensifier tubes.

announcements.headline: Exosens secures a major order for 25,000 image intensifier tubes to power night vision devices
announcements.insight: The order for image intensifier tubes follows the SBTi validation. This commercial step complements the earlier climate target confirmation.

announcements.headline: Exosens’ climate targets validated by the Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi)
announcements.insight: Exosens Shs has had its climate targets validated by the Science Based Targets initiative. This may enhance its ESG credentials for institutional investors.
